cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
  vessel,
  AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY hour, vessel
ORDER BY hour, vessel
LIMIT 5000

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings
FROM telemetry
GROUP BY vessel
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
  vessel,
  wave_height AS max_wave
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '14 days'
ORDER BY hour, vessel
LIMIT 10000

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS t,
  vessel,
  water_temp AS temp
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '14 days'
ORDER BY t, vessel

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
